stages.name: SS1 Moab Sand Flats (sample)
stages.description: A short starter stage on Sand Flats Road and the Porcupine Rim 4x4 trail east of Moab, with a speed zone at the town edge. A good first file to open and edit.

stages.name: Skeleton Coast SS1: Springbokwasser - Torra Bay - Terrace Bay
stages.region: Skeleton Coast National Park, Kunene, Namibia
stages.description: Fast gravel down the C39 from the park gate to the Atlantic, with a camp-site speed zone at Torra Bay. Patterned after classic Dakar road-to-the-coast stages.

stages.name: Skeleton Coast SS2: Terrace Bay - Mowe Bay dune crossing
stages.region: Skeleton Coast National Park, Kunene, Namibia
stages.description: A short road transfer out of Terrace Bay, then 60+ km of off-piste through the coastal dune belt to Möwe Bay. A Dakar-style dune marathon day.

stages.name: Skeleton Coast SS3: Sesfontein - Hoanib river - Amspoort
stages.description: Out of Sesfontein, then down the dry Hoanib river bed to Amspoort. Patterned after African river-bed stages and Kaokoland rallies.

stages.name: Skeleton Coast SS4: Sanitatas - Orupembe - Hartmann's Valley
stages.description: Rocky Kaokoveld tracks through Orupembe, then off-piste up Hartmann's Valley. A mountain-and-sand day in the style of Rallye du Maroc and Dakar.

stages.name: Rallye du Maroc style: Rissani - Erg Chebbi - Taouz
stages.description: Stony piste from Rissani, a village zone in Merzouga, then an off-piste loop around Erg Chebbi to Taouz. Patterned after the Rallye du Maroc.

stages.name: Africa Eco Race style: M'Hamid - Erg Chigaga - Lac Iriki - Foum Zguid
stages.description: Village zone at M'Hamid, the dunes of Erg Chigaga, then the dry lake of Lac Iriki into Foum Zguid. Patterned after the Africa Eco Race.

stages.name: Dakar style: AlUla - Hegra canyons
stages.description: Fast tracks between sandstone mesas, sandy canyons and short dune crossings near Hegra. Patterned after the Dakar's AlUla stages.

stages.name: Dakar style: Empty Quarter (Shubaytah) dune loop
stages.region: Rub al Khali near Shaybah, Eastern Province, Saudi Arabia
stages.description: Almost entirely off-piste in the giant dunes of the Empty Quarter, with long CAP legs and few waypoints. Patterned after Dakar's Shubaytah days.

stages.name: Dakar style: Ha'il - Jubbah - Nafud
stages.description: Fast road and gravel to Jubbah, then the red dunes of An Nafud. Patterned after the Dakar's Ha'il stages.

stages.name: Abu Dhabi Desert Challenge style: Qasr Al Sarab - Moreeb
stages.region: Liwa, Al Dhafra, Abu Dhabi, UAE
stages.description: Dunes from Qasr Al Sarab to Moreeb Dune and Liwa, with sabkha crossings. Patterned after the Abu Dhabi Desert Challenge.

stages.name: Dakar South America style: Fiambala dunes
stages.description: Out of Fiambalá through a speed zone, then the high-altitude Saujil dunes. Patterned after the Dakar's Argentina years.

stages.name: Finke Desert Race style: Alice Springs - Old South Road - Maryvale
stages.description: A long, flat-out sand and gravel run south on the Old South Road from Alice Springs toward Maryvale. Patterned after the Finke Desert Race.

stages.name: Baja 1000 style: Ojos Negros - Valle de Trinidad - Mike's Sky Rancho
stages.region: Ensenada / San Quintin, Baja California, Mexico
stages.description: Graded dirt out of Ojos Negros, Valle de la Trinidad, then the mountain road to Mike's Sky Rancho. Patterned after the SCORE Baja 1000.

stages.name: Silk Way style: Dalanzadgad - Bayanzag - Moltsog Els
stages.description: Steppe tracks to the Flaming Cliffs of Bayanzag, then a dune field. Patterned after the Silk Way Rally's Gobi stages.
